title_sq: Te Liqeni i Thate, Ne Kompleksin Green Terrace, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Super Pamje!!
description_sq: Te Liqeni i Thate, Ne Kompleksin Green Terrace, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Super Pamje!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje pallati 7 katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Ka nje siperfaqe bruto 172.2 m2 nga te cilat 117.8 siperfaqe e apartamentit, siperfaqe verande 29.4 m2, dhe siperfaqe e perbashket 25 m2. Apartamenti organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes sebashku me kendin e gatimit, dhome matrimoniale, dhome gjumi, 2 tualete, veranda e aksesueshme nga salloni ndenjes dhe dhoma matrimoniale. Apartamenti ka nje orientim drejt jugut, duke mundesuar ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites dhe nje pamje fantastike te zones. Ne pallatin ne te cillin ndodhet apartamenti jane realizuar punime shume cilesore: termoizolim, izolimi akustik, dritare dopioxham. Vendndodhja ne nje zone te qete e ben te pershtatshem per te realizuar nje jetese komode dhe larg zhurmave te qytetit. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion hipotekor per siperfaqen 117.8.
title_en: At Lake Dry, in the Green Terrace complex, 2+1 apartment for sale with a great view!!
description_en: At Lake Dry, in Green Terrace Complex, 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Great View!!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a well-managed 7-story building with an elevator. It has a gross area of ​​172.2 m2, of which 117.8 is the apartment area, 29.4 m2 of veranda area, and 25 m2 of common area. The apartment is organized by the living room together with the kitchen corner, matrimonial room, bedroom, 2 toilets, veranda accessible from the living room and matrimonial room. The apartment has an orientation towards the south, allowing natural lighting throughout the day and a fantastic view of the area. In the building in which the apartment is located, very high-quality works have been carried out: thermal insulation, acoustic insulation, double-glazed windows. The location in a quiet area makes it suitable for living a comfortable life away from the noise of the city. The apartment has mortgage documentation for the area 117.8.
